subject: world_language
concept: Mentoring or teaching a foundational concept of the target language to an earlier-stage learner, in the target language
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Craftsmanship Pillar's mentorship theme — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a simple explanation of a foundational concept appropriate for an earlier-stage learner
exercise.abstract: Student explains a foundational target-language concept clearly and accessibly, as if teaching an earlier-stage learner

assessment.mastery_threshold: explanation is genuinely accessible to a beginner, not just a restatement using advanced terminology
misconception_flags: explains the concept using terminology or complexity beyond what a genuine beginner could follow

interest_binding: concept generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
